maintenance_led.reason: Mostly sells new engines and power systems to OEMs for incorporation into new equipment; aftermarket parts and service are the smaller part.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private industrial and power-system OEMs (forklifts, generators, data centers); military vehicles are only a small niche.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by designing and selling its own emissions-certified engines and power systems; a partnership with HD Hyundai Infracore, not a roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Engines are emissions-certified and qualified into OEM products, with PSI as manufacturer of record; switching needs re-engineering and recertification.
